## Description

After an Agent restart, a P2P client re-attaches onto the new Agent's stream epoch without stating that the old timeline is gone. The xterm keeps the pre-restart buffer, the new epoch's cursor is seeded over it, and no degraded-history notice appears. History produced before the restart that the new Agent cannot replay (its ring began at the new process) is silently lost.

Found by the SC-05 Agent-restart fixture in PR #2192 (run 39705981048, P2P case, failed on all three attempts):

```
Locator: getByTestId('terminal-history-degraded')
Expected: visible
Error: element(s) not found
> e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts:826
```

The Relay case passes because its transport loss calls `noteStreamTruncated()` unconditionally; the P2P case defers that statement to "resume reports truncation", but the reattach path never makes that comparison.

## Reproduction

1. Attach to a session over P2P.
2. Print `RESTART-1926-BEFORE`.
3. Restart the real Agent process (same tmux session survives).
4. Wait for input to work again and print `RESTART-1926-AFTER`.
5. Read the buffer: `RESTART-1926-BEFORE` is absent, and `terminal-history-degraded` is absent.

Deterministic browser fixture: `terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts` → `an Agent restart recovers without claiming unproven history over P2P (#1926 SC-05)` (PR #2192).

## Root Cause (verified)

- `web/src/platform/session-runtime/SessionRuntime.ts:1368-1376` — on a P2P transport loss with a known `p2pAttachSeed.streamEpoch`, `noteStreamTruncated()` is deliberately deferred until resume reports truncation.
- `SessionRuntime.ts:826-847` — the next attach computes `needsBootstrap` from the pre-loss state (false), then `onAttachOk` replaces `p2pAttachSeed` with the new epoch's `streamEpoch`/`streamCursor` without comparing it to the previous epoch.
- `SessionRuntime.ts:950` — `applyAttachSeedToLiveTransport()` seeds the reconciler with the new epoch and cursor; nothing states that the buffer content belongs to the old epoch.
- The Agent returns `epoch_match: false` on a resume for the old epoch (`crates/nession-protocol/src/contracts/terminal/v1.rs:339-379`), but the reattach path never asks: it seeds the new epoch directly.

## Impact

A terminal that survived an Agent restart looks continuous while its scrollback is missing everything the new Agent cannot replay. Recovery also never asks for the bootstrap that would repair it (the gap is never recorded), so the loss persists across the session.

## Fix Direction

When applying an attach seed whose `streamEpoch` differs from the previously observed epoch, call `noteStreamTruncated()` so `historyMayHaveGap`/`gapDetected` are set. The buffer is then explicitly degraded-live, the notice is visible (#2155), and the next attach requests a bootstrap (a tmux capture that replaces the buffer and can repair it). A same-epoch reattach and a first attach must not state a gap.

## Location

- `web/src/platform/session-runtime/SessionRuntime.ts` (`onAttachOk` seed application)
- `web/src/platform/session-runtime/__tests__/unit/SessionRuntime.test.ts`

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 A P2P reattach whose attach reply names a new `streamEpoch` sets the degraded-history state exactly once, and a same-epoch reattach leaves it clear.
- [ ] SC-02 The Agent-restart E2E over P2P either recovers the pre-restart history through a bootstrap or shows the degraded notice; it never presents the boundary as continuous without stating it.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality/E2E/Case Smoke and merge-SHA trusted Acceptance pass.

    when: pr

| SC-02 | Pending | run 39721032639; ref 6d1fe319eb8f0294dff2bcf43a81d02c57db2d6a; source agent-deepseek; file: e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts:954-958 — the degraded notice is asserted only when mode === 'Relay'; the P2P lane asserts neither bootstrap recovery nor the notice.; file: e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts:963-995 — for P2P, 'degraded' and the bootstrap wire facts are only logged (AGENT-RESTART-WIRE), never asserted.; file: e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts:944-946 — fixture comment says P2P may recover through Relay and the epoch-change statement is deferred until the fix lands.; file: web/src/product/terminal/patterns/TerminalSurface.tsx:213-216 — the notice renders only from historyDegraded (gapDetected), so a screen-only/incomplete bootstrap would show neither recovery nor the notice.; workflow: E2E / Tests run 39721032548 at 6d1fe319eb8f0294dff2bcf43a81d02c57db2d6a completed success (terminal-consistency-faults 11/11), but its passing assertions do not cover the P2P boundary outcome.; summary: The Agent-restart E2E over P2P does not assert either pre-restart-history recovery by bootstrap or the degraded notice, so the passing run cannot establish the criterion. |
